court: District of Columbia Court of Appeals

issues.label: Lay opinion identification of vehicle
issues.why: Whether Johnson's identification of the Maserati as Davis's from video was admissible lay opinion testimony.

issues.label: Johnson's build/physical resemblance testimony
issues.why: Whether Johnson's comparison of the shooter's build to Davis was proper and not unduly prejudicial.

issues.label: Consciousness of guilt evidence
issues.why: Whether the rim-color-change request and tarp-covered Maserati were admissible as consciousness-of-guilt evidence.

issues.label: Flight as evidence of guilt
issues.why: Whether Davis's departure to Costa Rica was admissible and properly instructed as flight evidence.

issues.label: Photo array identification reliability
issues.why: Whether Nance's out-of-court identification was unduly suggestive or otherwise inadmissible.

issues.label: In-court eyewitness identification reliability
issues.why: Whether Nance's identification testimony met reliability standards under due process.

issues.label: CSLI admissibility and foundation
issues.why: Whether cell-site location evidence was properly authenticated and admitted, and any Fourth Amendment issues.

issues.label: Chain of custody bullet fragments
issues.why: Whether physical/forensic evidence had adequate foundation.

issues.label: Sufficiency of evidence for one ADW
issues.why: Whether evidence supported the ADW conviction for the victim in the car behind.

issues.label: Intent element for ADW rear victim
issues.why: Whether firing generally toward rear cars establishes intent/apprehension for a specific victim.

issues.label: Identity of the shooter sufficiency
issues.why: Whether cumulative evidence sufficiently proved Davis was the gunman.

issues.label: Merger of PFCOV convictions
issues.why: Whether the four PFCOV counts were properly merged and sentenced.

issues.label: Merger of underlying assault convictions
issues.why: Whether AWIKWA and ADW counts merge under double jeopardy principles.

issues.label: Consecutive sentencing propriety
issues.why: Whether imposing fully consecutive sentences was legally permissible and reasonable.

issues.label: Multiple victims justify separate counts
issues.why: Whether distinct victims support separate assault convictions without merger.

issues.label: Intent to kill sufficiency (AWIKWA)
issues.why: Whether evidence established specific intent to kill Nance while armed.

issues.label: Standard of review for each claim
issues.why: Whether errors were preserved determining harmless-error versus plain-error review.

issues.label: Harmlessness of any evidentiary error
issues.why: Whether any erroneously admitted evidence was harmless given other proof.

issues.label: Cumulative error effect
issues.why: Whether combined errors, if any, deprived Davis of a fair trial.

issues.label: AWIKWA transferred/specific intent for children
issues.why: Whether ADW against children required distinct intent given shots aimed at Nance.
